name: magnetic-dock
title: Magnetic Dock
description: A dock where icons gravitate toward the pointer within an influence field: displacement falls off with distance (inverse-square), neighbours lean toward the cursor, and the dock lifts as a whole when engaged.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Playful
Macrostructure: Rail
Density: Medium
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Kinetic
Typography: Grotesk
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Pointer Field: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
